name: tw01-scs-0826-1500
js: const H = 225, sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), lvl = () => { v.director.setHeading(H); v.state.heading = H; v.state.bankDeg = 0; }; const w = v.director.weather; lvl(); w.onJump(); await sleep(15000); lvl(); w.onJump(); await sleep(1500); const d = w.describe(); v.director.setActive(false); lvl(); await sleep(3000); lvl(); return d + ' | 砧顶 ' + v.weather.storms.map((s) => s.top.toFixed(1)).join(',');

name: tw01-scs-0826-1500-face
js: const H = 225, sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)), lvl = () => { v.director.setHeading(H); v.state.heading = H; v.state.bankDeg = 0; }; const w = v.director.weather; lvl(); w.onJump(); await sleep(15000); lvl(); w.onJump(); await sleep(1500); const d = w.describe(); v.director.setActive(false); const [px, pz] = w.host.localPos(); const near = v.weather.storms.slice().sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - px, a.z - pz) - Math.hypot(b.x - px, b.z - pz))[0]; const brg = Math.atan2(near.x - px, -(near.z - pz)) * 180 / Math.PI; const H2 = (brg - 90 + 360) % 360; v.director.setHeading(H2); v.state.heading = H2; v.state.bankDeg = 0; await sleep(3000); v.director.setHeading(H2); v.state.heading = H2; v.state.bankDeg = 0; return '（截图用：航向转到 ' + Math.round(H2) + '°，让窗外正对最近的单体）' + d + ' | 砧顶 ' + v.weather.storms.map((s) => s.top.toFixed(1)).join(',');
